name: Spellstriker Staff
text:
A spellstriker staff is wrought iron with gleaming arcane sigils etched into its surface and a sharp point at the bottom. Used as a weapon, the staff is a +1 striking shifting staff.

---
Activate F (concentrate)

Frequency once per hour

Trigger You use Spellstrike with a non-cantrip spell and miss with the Strike

---
Effect An explosion of magical energy—stored up for the Spellstrike—explodes out. All creatures in a 5-foot emanation take 1d6 damage per rank of the spell, with a basic Reflex save save against your spell DC. This damage is the same type the spell would have dealt, and the activation gains that trait; if the spell would have dealt multiple types of damage, choose one of them. If the damage of the explosion is mental, the save is basic Will save instead of Reflex.

---
Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list.
- Cantrip Ignition
- 1st Echoing Weapon, Sure Strike
- 2nd Acid Grip, Telekinetic Maneuver

---
Craft Requirements You have the magus's Spellstrike activity. Supply one casting of all listed ranks of all listed spells.
